children: Australian shares were expected to open higher on Friday, with potential gains in mining and gold stocks on the back of underlying commodity prices, while Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller's remarks eased U.S. rate hike fears among investors globally.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.3%, a 16.9-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark closed 0.5% higher on Thursday.
